CRISP CLEAR AIR: still, sharp air stretching far, every distant ridge and rooftop crisp and clean to the eye
CRISP DRY BREEZE: a cool clean breeze moving through, carrying the far details razor-sharp across the open distance
CLEAR STILL AIR: dry, still air holding every far hillside in perfect crisp focus, clean and cool
SHARP COOL AIR: the air cool and transparent, far slopes standing out hard-edged and vivid in the clean dry stillness
CLEAN OPEN AIR: a gentle cool breeze keeping the air crystal-clear, the farthest ridgelines sharp against the distance
SOFT VALLEY HAZE: a soft haze layering the far hills paler and paler toward the horizon, the near ground crisp
WARM HEAT SHIMMER: a slow liquid shimmer hanging over the far stretch of road, the distant ground rippling gently
PALE HAZE ON THE HILLS: a warm milky haze softening the far slopes layer by layer into pale washes of colour
DISTANT HAZE VEIL: a soft golden haze hanging across the mid-distance, the far hills fading to the palest suggestion
GROUND MIST IN THE HOLLOW: a knee-high white mist lying along the valley floor below the route, thinning to clear air above
SEA MIST ON THE POINT: a soft sea mist drifting in and gently blurring the far headland into pale grey
THIN MIST ON THE WATER: a thin pale mist lying flat over the water surface, softening the far shore to a whisper
VALLEY FLOOR MIST: a still white mist pooled low in the valley, lying quiet and thick in the deep hollow
SOFT DRIZZLE: a fine soft drizzle hanging in the air, beading every surface and blurring the middle distance to grey
WET ROAD SHINE: rain just passing, the road gleaming and every wet surface holding a bright soft reflection
AFTER-RAIN GLISTEN: rain ended, the air washed and fresh, every leaf and stone glistening in the returning light
FAT SLOW SNOWFLAKES: fat soft flakes drifting straight down through still air, settling slow and even over everything
FINE STEADY SNOWFALL: a fine steady fall of small flakes thickening the air, the far distance fading to soft white
SNOW JUST ENDING: the fall just stopping, the air sparkling with the last drifting flakes catching the pale light
GOLDEN DUST HAZE: a soft golden dust haze hanging low over the dry track, warm and still in the heavy air
LOW DUST SHIMMER: fine dry dust hanging in a faint shimmer just above the parched ground, glowing in the heat
DRY GOLDEN AIR: a dry golden haze drifting soft and low across the open flats, the far distance warm and blurred
FOG BANK IN THE HOLLOW: a thick fog bank lying deep in the hollow below, the route riding clear above the white mass
LOW CLOUD IN THE VALLEY: low cloud filling the valley floor in a slow rolling layer, the high ground standing free above
DRIFTING FOG BELOW: slow fog drifting through the low ground, pooling in every hollow while the upper air stays open
